intelligence.enrichment: Seeds with two cotyledons are dicotyledons and dicot plants have reticulate venation with a taproot system; seeds with a single cotyledon are monocotyledons and monocot plants have parallel venation with a fibrous root system. cotyledon_count -> seed_type -> venation_and_root_system The learner correctly applies this rule: Seeds with two cotyledons are dicotyledons and dicot plants have reticulate venation with a taproot system; seeds with a single cotyledon are monocotyledons and monocot plants have parallel venation with a fibrous root system. Cotyledons are just seed pieces; leaf venation and root type are unrelated to whether a seed has one or two cotyledons.
